summary: Iteration 10 testing of Fish It: (1) admin-driven password reset (backend + UI prompt flow), (2) VIP extra_allowed_chats plan gating (backend strip + frontend disabled state), (3) code review of group kickstart in automation_engine, and full regression (backend pytest suite + all dashboard pages, mobile drawer, config persistence, account switcher). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_reset_vipgating.py: 11/11 pass. Full backend suite: 130/130 pass (-n0). All frontend flows passed.

minor.issue: No delete-user endpoint exists; admin can only disable. Test/temp users accumulate (113 users in admin list, mostly test_* accounts from previous iterations). Consider an admin delete endpoint or seeded cleanup.

Gating silently strips extra_allowed_chats for free/basic with no response signal (no warning field / 200 with silent mutation). Works as specced, but a client on Starter that had default VIP bots pre-filled loses them on first save without feedback.

issues: Mobile menu button and sidebar nav links have no data-testid (only login/page-level testids exist) — reduces test robustness; drawer itself works and shows all 7 nav links.
Save action shows no persistent/verifiable success toast text matched within 2.5s of clicking Simpan (data did persist after reload). Consider a stable toast with data-testid.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid to mobile menu button + sidebar nav links in DashboardLayout.
Optional: add admin DELETE user endpoint to clean the 100+ accumulated test users.
Optional: surface a toast/testid on Configuration save success.
critical_code_review_comments: automation_engine._cycle_group kickstart verified: self._group_kickstarted initialised in __init__ and reset in start(); on first cycle, when not _session_likely_running, it sets status 'opening', drains queue and sends _group_open_command(cfg) = /open_mancing@<bot_username stripped of @> to the group, logging 'START → Sent <cmd> → <group>' with try/except on send. _cycle_vip unchanged and still sends cfg.open_command (/mancing) immediately when no session is likely running. Live MTProto not testable (no api_id/api_hash) — static review only.

admin_routes.reset_password: correct 404 on unknown id, min_length=6 → 422, get_current_admin → 403 for non-admin, uses hash_password (bcrypt). Verified old password rejected (401) and new one accepted end-to-end via API and UI.
automation_routes.update_config gating verified for free/basic (stripped to '') and pro/elite (preserved), including persistence via GET.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_boost_filter.py (updated stale expectation: its fixture user is free-plan, so extra_allowed_chats is now correctly stripped to '')
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway users test_iter10_*@example.com (registered via API) for reset-password/plan-gating tests and one UI user test_iter10_ui@example.com. All deleted via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iter10.py. Note: cleanup also removed extra telegram sub-accounts of user@fishit.app (one 'Akun 2' pre-existed before my test and was deleted — it had no Telegram session, only account row).
test_credentials: admin@fishit.app / Admin@Fishit2026 (unchanged); user@fishit.app / FishIt#2026 (unchanged) — seeded passwords were NOT reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response key is 'access_token' (not 'token'); register lowercases email. New suite tests/test_iter10_reset_vipgating.py covers admin reset-password (422/403/401/404/200 + login with new pwd) and extra_allowed_chats gating across free/basic/pro/elite. test_iter5_boost_filter expectation was updated for gating. Group kickstart remains code-review-only (no Telegram api_id/api_hash). Use cleanup_iter10.py pattern to remove temp users since there is no admin DELETE endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: Only failure found was a stale test expectation in test_iter5_boost_filter.py (free-plan fixture user expecting extra_allowed_chats to persist) — caused by the new plan gating; test updated, no product bug.
